notes: The input string is guaranteed to be a valid Roman numeral in canonical modern form.
Use a small mapping from characters to values and scan left-to-right; when a smaller value precedes a larger one, apply subtractive logic.
Output must be an exact integer (no extra whitespace or formatting).
constraints: s contains only the characters I, V, X, L, C, D, M
s is a valid Roman numeral representing a value in [1, 3999]
Expected time complexity: O(n); expected extra space: O(1).
content.inputFormat: Single line: JSON array of one string: [s]. Example: ["MCMXCIV"]
content.problemStatement:
Roman numerals are represented by seven symbols: `I`, `V`, `X`, `L`, `C`, `D`, `M` with values 1, 5, 10, 50, 100, 500 and 1000 respectively. Normally symbols are written from largest to smallest and their values are added. To avoid repeating a symbol four times in a row, subtractive notation is used in six cases: `IV` (4), `IX` (9), `XL` (40), `XC` (90), `CD` (400) and `CM` (900).

With a valid Roman numeral string `s`, convert it to an integer and output the result. The input is guaranteed to be a valid Roman numeral representing an integer in the range `[1, 3999]`.

Create an implementation of a solution that runs in O(n) time and O(1) extra space (excluding input/output).

notes: All hidden testcases are valid Roman numerals representing integers in [1, 3999].
The judge compares integer equality (exact match).
Whitespace around the output line will be trimmed by the harness; the numeric value must match exactly.
Expected time complexity: O(n); expected auxiliary space: O(1).

solution.approach: Scan the string left-to-right using a small mapping from Roman characters to integer values. Maintain a running total and the previous character value. For each character, add its value; if the previous value is smaller than the current, subtract twice the previous value (to correct the earlier addition and apply subtractive notation). This yields O(n) time and O(1) extra space.

hidden.label: Minimum valid input - single character I (value 1)
Mixed additive with largest value first - VI (5+1)
All symbols in descending order - MDCLXVI (largest to smallest)
Subtractive pattern inside larger number - MCDXC (1490)
Pattern with XC and IV - XCIV (94)
Near maximum with mixed patterns - MMMDCCCXC (3890)
